data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Love the selections at Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a0610c494a167109ac4acd8)
I love the selections that Lulu and Georgia has curated. The delivery was rather timely and I did have a return to make because the towel color wasn't quite what I expected, but that process was easy. 

The Ferm Living - Sand / Waste Basket I ordered was slightly damaged, the top edge is bent, most likely happened in shipping. I think that the packaging on that piece should have been more padded. 

Otherwise, I will continue to shop here and recommend.

May 5, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 15, 2026

Meagan Odell,

We appreciate your positive feedback regarding our selections and the ease of your return. We are sorry to hear about the damaged waste basket and will certainly review our packaging procedures to prevent similar issues in the future. We value your continued support and recommendations.

Lulu and Georgia
